description: Live gateway and vLLM metrics from Prometheus only. Nothing on this dashboard reads ClickHouse.

options.content:
### Prometheus only
Metrics are exposed on the gateway at `GET /v1/metrics` and scraped by Prometheus every **5s** (`monitoring/prometheus.yml`).

In-memory structures (counters, quantile streams) are mirrored into Prometheus on the hot path; this dashboard does **not** use ClickHouse tables or the 15s emit flush.

panels.description:
**Source:** `TotalCounter` → Prometheus cumulative counter `gateway_total_requests{team_id}` (in-memory window map is separate and used only for ClickHouse).

**Dump / scrape interval:** Counter updated on each completed proxy request. Prometheus scrape every **5s**. Panel uses `rate(...[1m])`.
panels.title: Request rate by team

panels.description:
**Source:** `ActiveCounter` → Prometheus gauge `gateway_inflight_requests{team_id}` (inc on proxy entry, dec on exit).

**Dump / scrape interval:** Real-time gauge; scraped every **5s**. Not written to ClickHouse.
panels.title: In-flight requests by team

panels.description:
**Source:** `LatencyRegistry` (quantile stream) → sample observer → Prometheus histogram `gateway_request_latency_bucket{team_id}` (end-to-end proxy latency in ms).

**Dump / scrape interval:** One histogram observation per completed request. Scraped every **5s**. Panel: `histogram_quantile` over **5m** rate windows (not the 15s ClickHouse emit).
panels.title: Gateway latency percentiles

panels.description:
**Source:** `TTFT` `LatencyRegistry` → Prometheus histogram `gateway_request_ttft_bucket{team_id}` (only when streaming sets ttft_ms > 0).

**Dump / scrape interval:** Per request when TTFT recorded; scrape **5s**. Non-streaming traffic leaves this empty today.
panels.title: Time to first token (p95)
vLLM process metrics (Prometheus scrape of mock-vllm / vLLM)

panels.description:
**Source:** vLLM Prometheus exposition `vllm:num_requests_running` (job `mock-vllm`, not the gateway binary).

**Dump / scrape interval:** Prometheus scrape every **5s**. A copy is also inserted into ClickHouse `vllm_system_metrics` every **15s** (see ClickHouse dashboard).
panels.title: vLLM running requests

panels.description:
**Source:** vLLM gauge `vllm:num_requests_waiting` (queue depth).

**Dump / scrape interval:** Prometheus scrape every **5s**. ClickHouse copy every **15s** in `vllm_system_metrics.queue_depth`.
panels.title: vLLM queue depth (waiting)
